git_head: unavailable/unborn; reviewed current source pinned by protocol SHA256
strengths: Dual-frame nearest-set distances use same-eye anchor world coordinates and each capture own estimated body coordinates; current selector code matches the frozen equations.
Anchor is the latest strictly prior retained capture within 10 seconds satisfying at least 0.2m estimated translation; missing/empty compatible support yields HOLD.
Joint action requires every original sourcepoint in each nonempty cell to witness body<=0.1m and world>=0.2m; original point mapping, eye and source identity metadata are checked.

All advisory generation seals before replay; full replay seals before physical action teacher reads. Geometry generation uses only source cloud/pose and original cell metadata; no learned feature/weight inference is present.
Unchanged immutable CaptureAdmission consumes rejected original capture identities, protects old history, creates no free cells, and does not resurrect rejected risk.
Scoring uses original unfiltered source support for both B and Q, all 40052 action rows, 1910 times and 1010 B map matches with per-sequence gates.
Supervision records one dispatch, no automatic retries, and bounded process-group cleanup; heuristic limitations and closed historical budgets are stated explicitly.

important.title: Enforce the frozen scoring/replay input hashes before dispatch
important.issue: protocol.input_sha256 contains 3024 pinned inputs, including action_seal, occupancy, target/prior/policy records and old B maps, but no execution stage checks that dictionary. Code hashes and generation inputs are checked, while score loads the teacher seal and occupancy/target inputs without their protocol pins. Per-row teacher SHA checks are only anchored to the unpinned action_seal itself.
important.impact: Changed scoring inputs can silently change teacher classes, physical truth or the original denominators while producing an apparently complete result under the frozen protocol. This violates the immutable-input preflight contract.
important.fix: After the full prediction seal exists, verify the original protocol input_sha256 hashes before the replay/scoring stages use them, or verify each respective frozen hash immediately before read. Hashing bytes does not decode teacher labels; preserve prediction-first and replay-before-teacher-scoring order. Refresh only code SHA pins for this implementation repair before actual dispatch.

minor.title: Seven fixtures do not explicitly cover multi-eye anchor isolation
minor.issue: All coordinate fixtures use one eye. Code inspection confirms same-eye queries, but the fixtures would not catch a future cross-eye mix or wrong latest eligible anchor.
minor.recommendation: A later purely synthetic fixture can use two eyes with deliberately conflicting anchor clouds and several eligible/ineligible prior captures. This is not a reason to reopen fixed data candidate budgets.
